# Quantara

> Quantara is AI-assisted BOQ measurement and quantity calculation software for construction professionals. It brings supported project sources, reviewable extraction, AI Draft BOQ, guided measurement, deterministic quantity calculations, validation and professional BOQ outputs into one controlled workflow.

## What Quantara does

Quantara helps construction professionals move from supported project evidence toward a reviewable BOQ. Supported workflows include text-based PDF table-row extraction, structured XLSX/CSV import, reviewed extracted information, guided BOQ measurement, visible deterministic engineering calculations, voice-assisted measurement and BOQ editing, controlled Google Drive import, supported Autodesk / AutoCAD DWG analysis, BOQ validation and professional document outputs.

AI Draft BOQ can assemble usable extracted evidence into an editable draft before every extraction issue has been individually resolved. Supported source and quantity provenance is preserved where available. Missing quantity or unit information remains visible for professional completion instead of being invented, and commercial rates are not silently fabricated. AI Draft BOQ is a draft workflow and is not automatic professional approval.

## TAYQAN — AI Quantity Surveyor / Digital QS

TAYQAN is Quantara's governed AI Quantity Surveyor workflow. It can carry work through source discovery, source processing, evidence review, quantity preparation, governed rate preparation when requested, BOQ assembly, validation / final QA, and a Ready for Acceptance state.

TAYQAN does not automatically approve, issue, lock, tender-submit or certify a BOQ. It must not invent missing geometry, dimensions, quantities or rates. Final professional acceptance remains under human control.

Current TAYQAN hire options are:
- TAYQAN Day: AED 299 one-time for a 24-hour hire, up to 2 distinct projects.
- TAYQAN Week: AED 999 one-time for a 7-day hire.
- TAYQAN Monthly / Digital QS: AED 2,499 per month.

TAYQAN hire is commercially separate from the core Quantara SaaS subscription.

## Quantara subscription pricing

Published core subscription prices are:
- Starter: AED 149 per month or AED 1,490 per year.
- Professional: AED 399 per month or AED 3,990 per year.
- Business: AED 899 per month or AED 8,990 per year.

A user chooses a public plan, creates or signs in to an account, and continues to eligible authenticated checkout when the selected approved price is active and synchronized.

## Important capability boundaries

Quantara does not currently perform OCR text extraction from scanned or image-only PDFs. Image-only pages can be detected, but their content requires manual transcription.

Quantara does not make a blanket claim of fully unattended computer-vision takeoff from arbitrary drawing geometry. This limitation does not apply to the available guided BOQ measurement, deterministic quantity calculation, or supported Autodesk / AutoCAD DWG analysis workflows.

Generic CAD/BIM/IFC model quantity extraction is not claimed as a current capability.

Project information, extracted data, measurements, calculations, rates and outputs require review by the responsible construction professional before tender, procurement, contractual or construction use. Quantara and TAYQAN assist the Quantity Surveyor workflow; they do not automatically replace professional responsibility or approval.

## Citation guidance

Use the public page that directly supports a statement. Do not infer unavailable capabilities, certifications, regulatory compliance, hosting location, guaranteed speed, guaranteed accuracy or professional approval from general marketing language.
